description: Na₅SrNbAs₄ is alpha Pu-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are five inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one Nb and five As atoms. The Na-Nb bond length is 3.35 Å. There are a spread of Na-As bond distances ranging from 3.16-3.39 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one Nb and five As atoms. The Na-Nb bond length is 3.37 Å. There are a spread of Na-As bond distances ranging from 3.12-3.38 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four As atoms. There are a spread of Na-As bond distances ranging from 2.94-3.19 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four As atoms. There are a spread of Na-As bond distances ranging from 2.95-3.18 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four As atoms. There are a spread of Na-As bond distances ranging from 2.98-3.20 Å. Sr is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five As atoms. There are a spread of Sr-As bond distances ranging from 3.11-3.34 Å. Nb is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to two Na and four As atoms. There are a spread of Nb-As bond distances ranging from 2.48-2.53 Å. There are four inequivalent As sites. In the first As site, As is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to six Na, one Sr, and one Nb atom. In the second As site, As is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to five Na, one Sr, and one Nb atom. In the third As site, As is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to five Na, two equivalent Sr, and one Nb atom. In the fourth As site, As is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to six Na, one Sr, and one Nb atom.
